summary: Four churches, all with weekend and weekday Masses printed in the sidebar and Mass list of all three readable bulletins, plus the Reconciliation box, Tuesday Adoration at St. Patrick and Thursday Adoration at St. James. A parish-wide line puts Confession 30 minutes before each weekday Mass (included per POLICY). Open: Thursday Confession start at St. James (5:00 or 5:15) and the First Friday Adoration hours at St. John's (9 AM or noon start). Dated: a Latin First Saturday Mass and Confession at St. James on Nov 7.
